scope: Formatting-only candidate for admitted Beagle scientific-logistics-01 and caroline-01 groups. No relationship re-adjudication, accepted mutation or export.
method: Used accepted primary notes/decisions and direct source HTML. Requirements target actual voice/date/figure/markup boundaries; quotes are feature-bearing body passages and source pins are hash-verified.

requirements.requirement: Keep the Conservators report as a joint Robert Waring Darwin/Charles Darwin voice record, not a single author’s letter.

evidence.quote: fossil Bones collected during the voyage

requirements.notes: Joint signatures Robt. FitzRoy and Charles Darwin are in the closing signature block; preserve that header/signature layer separately.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the joint FitzRoy/Darwin signature and the separate dated sea section.

evidence.quote: On the whole, balancing all that we have heard

requirements.notes: Do not flatten the joint voice into Charles alone.

requirements.requirement: Retain the actual terrace/landscape image and its connection to the geological observation; do not export an image description as prose.

evidence.quote: The recent elevation of the land above the level of the ocean is shown by beds of shells

requirements.notes: Accepted source visual must remain separate from authorial text.

requirements.requirement: Keep this multi-author family input sequence and address/receipt wording distinct from Caroline’s own voice.

evidence.quote: Papa’s eyes were full of tears

requirements.notes: The body relays family reactions and reported Captain detail.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the April 3 section date and separate the prior Bahia departure; do not collapse voyage dates.

evidence.quote: tomorrow the 3d of April we expect to arrive

requirements.notes: The body contains route and illness chronology, not a single undifferentiated date.

requirements.requirement: Keep the October 24 section and its later continuation distinct from the July/November family dates.
requirements.notes: Composition, arrival and later referenced correspondence remain separate.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the August 9 date and receipt of Caroline’s March 9 letter as distinct events.

evidence.quote: I received your letter, dated March 9th. the day before yesterday

requirements.notes: The incoming letter date and Darwin’s writing date must not be merged.

requirements.requirement: Render the July interval as an interval and retain the statement that three months of letters were missing.

evidence.quote: I have received the three months letters which were missing

requirements.notes: The body establishes a mail gap and expected future letters, not exact physical receipt.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the sealed-first-letter/together dispatch sequence and weekday/date layer without selecting an unsupported exact day.

evidence.quote: I had sealed up the first letter, all ready to be sent off during my absence

requirements.notes: The two letters go together; the body does not prove receipt.

requirements.requirement: Keep the family letter’s recurring first-Tuesday dispatch schedule separate from received-letter claims.

evidence.quote: we have written by the first of Tuesday of every month

requirements.notes: Planned monthly dispatch is not evidence of Darwin receipt or reading.

requirements.requirement: Preserve the embedded editorial cover label and unopened/forwarding mail distinction.

evidence.quote: I will leave this letter at Ascencion to take its chance of being forwarded

requirements.notes: The body is Darwin’s outgoing forwarding plan; any cover annotation remains outside it.

requirements.requirement: Keep Erasmus’s reported financial message and Caroline’s surrounding narrative as separate voices.

evidence.quote: My Father desires his kindest love to you

requirements.notes: Family relay is not Caroline-authored fact or a Darwin response.

requirements.requirement: Preserve Henslow’s quoted note as third-party correspondence and later knowledge, not as a direct Caroline prompt.

evidence.quote: a note came to my Father on Xmas day from Profr. Henslow

requirements.notes: The quoted note is an independent incoming witness with its own date and voice.

recommendations: Keep joint and family-reported voices, headers, cover annotations, embedded reports and quotations separate.
Preserve actual figures and date sections; do not infer receipt from planned dispatch or recurring schedules.
Treat repeated wording as a possible source artifact only when demonstrated; otherwise retain literal text or hold.
